description: Practice questions based on your Vasco da Gama notes.

questions.question: In which year did Vasco da Gama reach Calicut?
questions.explanation: Vasco da Gama reached Calicut on 20 May 1498.

questions.question: Who was the ruler of Calicut when Vasco da Gama arrived?
questions.explanation: The ruler of Calicut was known as the Zamorin or Samuthiri.

questions.question: From which city did Vasco da Gama begin his first voyage in 1497?
questions.explanation: His first voyage departed from Lisbon, Portugal, on 8 July 1497.

questions.question: Which explorer rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488?
questions.explanation: Bartolomeu Dias rounded the southern tip of Africa in 1488.

questions.question: Where did Vasco da Gama die?
questions.explanation: Vasco da Gama died in Cochin on 24 December 1524.
